name: puker
description: Poker web (Texas Hold'em) para jugar con amigos desde PC o celular

scripts.build: npm -w @puker/shared run build && npm -w @puker/server run build && npm -w @puker/client run build
scripts.test: npm -w @puker/shared run test && npm -w @puker/server run test
scripts.typecheck: npm -w @puker/shared run build && npm -w @puker/server exec tsc --noEmit && npm -w @puker/client exec tsc --noEmit
